annotations.title: Verify Agentic Base USDC On-Chain Payment & Unlock Bundle

description: Verify an autonomous x402 Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453) USDC ERC-20 Transfer transaction (tx_hash) to the Calligraphy Treasury Wallet ('0x0119f2F064669593d95bfA7C340d05E2386f8b03') with strict anti-replay protection and immediately unlock calligraphy_download_fab_bundle. Use this tool after executing the Base USDC transfer from calligraphy_get_crypto_payment_intent (for multi-chain Arbitrum/Polygon/Ethereum or USDT transfers to per-job deposit addresses, use calligraphy_verify_stablecoin_payment instead). Requires job_id and a 0x-prefixed 66-character tx_hash. Returns JSON with unlocked=True, payment_rail='agentic_base_usdc', matched_transfer_count, and recipient_wallet; if ERC20_RECIPIENT_MISMATCH, INSUFFICIENT_PAYMENT_AMOUNT, or TX_HASH_REPLAY_DETECTED occurs, inspect the error_code.

job_id.description: Compilation job identifier being unlocked by the Base Mainnet USDC transfer. Example: 'job_01'.

tx_hash.description: 0x-prefixed 66-character hexadecimal transaction hash on Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453) transferring exact_amount_usdc of USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913) to 0x0119f2F064669593d95bfA7C340d05E2386f8b03.
